evidence: Computed entirely server-side on the Hopsworks platform. Ingested training_data.csv into an online-enabled feature group (leakage_online v1) and ran SQL aggregations against the online store (RonDB). Pearson correlation of each feature with label: f1=0.074, f2=0.016, f3=0.992, f4=0.098, f5=0.007, f6=0.071 -- f3 is near-perfectly correlated while all others are ~0. Per-class separation confirms leakage: for label=0 f3 in [-0.421, 0.457] (mean -0.005), for label=1 f3 in [1.990, 2.935] (mean 2.496) -- the two classes do not overlap, so a single threshold (f3>1.2) classifies with 100% accuracy. f3 was clearly computed from post-outcome data.
